description: This file contains the PHP source code for an API controller class named Api within the Opencart.Admin.Controller.User namespace. It provides various methods for managing user API endpoints, including listing APIs, editing API details, saving APIs, and handling form submissions.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Controller class handling various API endpoints related to user API management, including listing, editing, and viewing APIs, with methods corresponding to each route.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point initializing the API page, setting the document title, breadcrumbs, and rendering the main API view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to display the list of APIs, configuring pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of API entries according to the specified filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Handles the API creation/edit form, loading existing data if an api_id is provided, or preparing blank data for new entries.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving of API data received from the form submission, updating or creating records accordingly.
